mapper.select: SELECT MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 1, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS sun, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 2, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS mon, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 3, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS tue, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 4, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS wed, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 5, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS thu, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 6, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS fri, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 7, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS sat FROM ( SELECT (A.base_mon + ROWNUM -1) AS days, A.base_mon, ((TRUNC(base_mon + ROWNUM - 1, 'D') - TRUNC(TRUNC(base_mon + ROWNUM - 1, 'Y'), 'D')) / 7 + 1) AS WEEK_NUM FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE (#{plan_date}, 'yyyy-MM') base_mon FROM DUAL ) A, DICTIONARY B ) C WHERE C.days <= LAST_DAY(base_mon) GROUP BY week_num ORDER BY week_num

SELECT program_list_idx, member_yn, reservation_date, reservation_type, member_yn, program_name, use_time, notice, usage_agreement, total_people, enable_number_of_team, maximum_people_of_team, add_date, add_id, homepage_id, (select count(*) FROM EXP_RESERVATION B where B.program_list_idx = A.program_list_idx AND B.cancel_yn = 'N' AND B.cancel_user_yn = 'N') as apply_count, (select sum(C.application_people) FROM EXP_RESERVATION C where C.program_list_idx = A.program_list_idx AND cancel_yn = 'N' AND C.cancel_user_yn = 'N') as apply_people_count FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST A WHERE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(reservation_date, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(reservation_date, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMM') AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ORDER BY reservation_date, use_time

SELECT program_list_idx, reservation_date, reservation_type, member_yn, program_name, use_time, notice, usage_agreement, total_people, enable_number_of_team, maximum_people_of_team, add_date, add_id, homepage_id FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST WHERE program_list_idx = #{program_list_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXP_PROGRAM_LIST ( program_list_idx, reservation_date, reservation_type, member_yn, program_name, use_time, notice, usage_agreement, total_people, enable_number_of_team, maximum_people_of_team, add_date, add_id, homepage_id ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(program_list_idx),0)+1 FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST), #{reservation_date}, #{reservation_type}, #{member_yn}, #{program_name}, #{use_time}, #{notice}, #{usage_agreement}, #{total_people}, #{enable_number_of_team}, #{maximum_people_of_team}, SYSDATE, #{add_id}, #{homepage_id} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EXP_PROGRAM_LIST SET reservation_date = REPLACE(#{reservation_date}, '-', ''), reservation_type = #{reservation_type}, member_yn = #{member_yn}, program_name = #{program_name}, use_time = #{use_time}, notice = #{notice}, usage_agreement = #{usage_agreement}, total_people = #{total_people}, enable_number_of_team = #{enable_number_of_team}, maximum_people_of_team = #{maximum_people_of_team}, modify_date = SYSDATE, modify_id = #{modify_id} WHERE program_list_idx = #{program_list_idx}
